signatures.likelyCause: The AutoDL instance is stopped, the SSH port changed, or the SSH alias points at an old endpoint.
signatures.suggestedNextAction: Update the SSH alias/config for the target and verify with a status probe before treating remote jobs as failed.

signatures.likelyCause: SSH key, username, IdentityFile, or authorized_keys is not accepted by the remote host.
signatures.suggestedNextAction: Verify SSH config and key installation; do not retry training commands until authentication succeeds.

signatures.likelyCause: Remote network path or instance is unavailable.
signatures.suggestedNextAction: Check AutoDL instance status and retry only bounded status probes.

signatures.likelyCause: The current batch/window/resolution/model configuration exceeds available GPU memory.
signatures.suggestedNextAction: Reduce resolution, batch size, window length, or enable chunking before retrying.

signatures.likelyCause: Runtime is loading incompatible NVIDIA/CUDNN libraries before the conda environment libraries.
signatures.suggestedNextAction: Inspect LD_LIBRARY_PATH and put environment NVIDIA libraries before system libraries.

signatures.likelyCause: Checkpoint download is partial or corrupt.
signatures.suggestedNextAction: Re-download to a temp path, verify size/load, then atomically replace the checkpoint.

signatures.likelyCause: The repository expects a different dataset layout or metadata schema.
signatures.suggestedNextAction: Inspect the loader and build the smallest dataset-format adapter before retrying.

signatures.likelyCause: Evaluation image was downscaled below the LPIPS/VGG pooling minimum.
signatures.suggestedNextAction: Increase resolution or disable LPIPS for tiny smoke scenes.

signatures.likelyCause: The same command hash has already been recorded in this run.
signatures.suggestedNextAction: Review the earlier job before repeating expensive execution.
